Mobile game developers from Turkey raised nearly $400 million over 22 months—more than teams from any other countries
Published by
admin
Tags:
InvestGame
,
Türkiye
Recently, investors have been generously investing in Turkish mobile studios.
Match Villains
Such data was
presented
by analysts from InvestGame. They noted that for the period from January 1, 2025, to October 16, 2026, Turkish studios accounted for 39% of all private investments in mobile games. To be more precise, that’s $396 million out of $1.013 billion.
It is reported that in 2025, Turkish developers received $230 million, and for the incomplete 10 months of 2026, the remaining $166 million.
For comparison, below is the investment statistics for other regions over the reported 22 months:
Asia-Pacific region — $248 million;
North America — $217 million;
Europe — $105 million;
Latin America, Middle East, and North Africa — $47 million.
If we talk not about the amount, but the number of mobile game-related funding rounds, Turkey also showed impressive results. According to InvestGame data, from January 2025 to October 2026, Turkish developers attracted funds 39 times. This is two rounds more than teams from the USA and Canada combined during the same period. However, developers from Europe managed to organize a total of 52 rounds, and developers from the Asia-Pacific region — 86 rounds in total, but since the analysts did not provide a detailed breakdown by all countries, the numbers are difficult to compare.
The largest investment in Turkey went to Grand Games studio, which in May 2026 received $70 million. The second place went to Good Job Games ($60 million in July 2025), and rounding out the top three was Flow Games ($46 million in October 2026).
